components.name: Access Trail Card
components.description: The connected, three-step explanation that turns private access into one comprehensible trail.
components.html:
How private access works

  1. 1
    Pseudonymous by default

    No email, phone number, or legal name is required.

  2. 2
    Connected evidence

    Reports stay linked to one public profile ID.

  3. 3
    Recovery is in your hands

    One-time codes restore the same profile.
components.css: .ds-access-trail { position: relative; padding: 24px 22px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: var(--r-card); background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-access-trail::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 78px; bottom: 42px; left: 41px; width: 1px; background: var(--green-border); } .ds-access-trail h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-access-trail ol { list-style: none; display: grid; gap: 23px; margin: 24px 0 0; padding: 0; } .ds-access-trail li { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 40px 1fr; gap: 13px; } .ds-access-trail li > span { width: 40px; height: 40px; display: grid; place-items: center; z-index: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--green-light); color: var(--green); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(20,64,44,.14); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-access-trail strong { font-size: 14px; } .ds-access-trail p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--body); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.55; }

narrative.overview:
InvaTrace should feel like a trusted field notebook opened in clear daylight: calm, legible, practical, and ready to record consequential evidence without ceremony. Its conservation identity comes through a disciplined forest palette, leaf-and-lens mark, factual language, and modest organic details rather than decorative wilderness imagery.

The interface is a workhorse first. Quiet paper-like backgrounds, white task surfaces, compact controls, and precise hierarchy make long workflows easy to scan outdoors and under unreliable connectivity. Private access extends this world as a safeguarded field pass: public identifiers, secret recovery material, and installation status are separated by typography and structure, never by spectacle.
keyCharacteristics: Mobile-first field utility with sunlight-readable contrast and comfortable touch targets.
Forest green is the singular active voice; warm colors carry warning and risk semantics.
Inter does the daily work; IBM Plex Mono distinguishes coordinates, IDs, and recovery material.
Soft corners, hairline borders, and restrained ambient shadows keep surfaces practical.
Icons and plain-language labels reinforce state so color never acts alone.

rules.name: The One Living Accent Rule
rules.body: Forest is the only routine accent; its rarity keeps actions and active state unmistakable.

rules.name: The Semantic Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Amber and red are not decoration; each appearance must communicate attention, danger, or irreversible consequence.

rules.name: The Mono Means Exact Rule
rules.body: Use IBM Plex Mono only for coordinates, profile IDs, recovery codes, model versions, and similarly exact strings; ordinary copy and labels remain Inter.

rules.name: The Quiet Wordmark Rule
rules.body: Preserve the lowercase `inva` / `trace` construction, its weighted color split, and tight tracking; never convert it to all caps.

rules.name: The Field Reach Rule
rules.body: Mobile spacing and touch behavior are the source layout; larger screens add breathing room and parallel columns without rearranging the job.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Start with tone and border; add a documented shadow only when the surface actually rises above its context.

rules.name: The Closed Radius Scale Rule
rules.body: Reuse the button, input, card, sheet, pill, or circle shapes; do not invent near-duplicate corner values for a new component.

dos: Do make Forest the clear active voice and let daylight neutrals carry most of each screen.
Do reserve IBM Plex Mono for exact machine-readable strings.
Do keep every interactive target at least 44px and primary fields or buttons at 46px.
Do pair semantic color with an icon, label, or plain-language status.
Do preserve safe areas, keyboard focus, reduced-motion behavior, and the 16px mobile input floor.
Do use Lucide line icons at the established compact sizes.
donts: Don't add gradients, glass blur, parallax, or decorative shadow clouds.
Don't introduce purple or pink AI styling into the conservation utility palette.
Don't invent radii or elevations outside the documented scales.
Don't use emoji as functional icons or rely on hover-only affordances.
Don't turn the lowercase InvaTrace wordmark into all caps or recolor it outside its established Forest, Ink, white, and Sprout construction.
Don't let semantic amber or red become general-purpose decoration.
